name: 104-storage-recording-rules-install
command:
kubectl -n kof get configmap kof-record-vmrules-mothership -o jsonpath='{.data.values}' > /tmp/kof-record-rules.yaml
helm upgrade kof-storage oci://ghcr.io/k0rdent/kof/charts/kof-storage --version 1.6.0 -n kof --reuse-values -f /tmp/kof-record-rules.yaml --wait --timeout 5m
stdout:
Release "kof-storage" has been upgraded. Happy Helming!
